# system.registerSystemTool

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--since">since 1.1.0</span></div>

Register a Lua System Tool.

```lua
system.registerSystemTool(params)
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `params` |  | yes | table with elements: |

Fields of `params`:

- `name` (string or function): tool name
- `icon` (string): tool icon
- `create` (function, optional): handler called on widget creation, it will return the widget which is passed later to all functions
- `wakeup` (function, optional): handler called at each loop
- `event` (function, optional): handler called when an event is received (event not passed to the parent window if the handler returns True)
- `paint` (function, optional): paint function
- `close` (function, optional): handler called on page closed
- `title` (boolean, optional): title


## Returns

page index (integer)

## Examples

```lua title="From the official Ethos documentation"
local function init()
  system.registerSystemTool({name=name, icon=icon, create=create, wakeup=wakeup, event=event, paint=paint})
end
```
